violations.message: Dynamic SQL built by concatenating a variable — SQL injection risk
violations.suggestion: Use parameterized queries or sanitize/escape all external input
Handle or log the exception; never silently swallow errors

violations.message: NOLOCK reads uncommitted data — dirty, missing or duplicated rows
violations.suggestion: Protect shared state with a lock or use an immutable/atomic alternative

violations.message: Sensitive field written to a log or console — secrets persist in log storage
violations.suggestion: Log an identifier or a masked value instead of the secret itself

violations.message: [NON_ATOMIC_WRITE]: Password hash updated outside a transaction
violations.suggestion: Wrap the update in BEGIN TRANSACTION / COMMIT with error handling

violations.message: Privilege granted to PUBLIC — every login inherits it
violations.suggestion: Grant to a dedicated role instead of PUBLIC

violations.message: Internal error detail returned to the caller — leaks stack layout and paths
violations.suggestion: Log the detail server-side and return a generic error message

violations.message: [BROAD_PERMISSIONS]: SECURITY DEFINER function without a pinned search_path
violations.suggestion: Add SET search_path = pg_catalog, public to the function

violations.message: Dynamic SQL built by || concatenation — SQL injection risk
violations.suggestion: Use parameterized queries or sanitize/escape all external input

violations.message: Every exception swallowed with WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL
violations.suggestion: Handle or log the exception; never silently swallow errors

violations.message: GRANT ALL hands out every privilege on the object
violations.suggestion: Grant only the privileges the role needs

violations.message: Credential embedded in a connection string inside SQL
violations.suggestion: Use a stored credential or user mapping, never a literal password
